// Negative fixture: every pattern below sits somewhere the sweep must NOT look.
// "http://localhost:8000" "C:\\Users\\x" "/home/someone" "powershell" 9875
/* block comment: "qontinui-dev-notes/plans" 0f8fad5b-d9cb-469f-a165-70867728950e */
/// doc comment: QONTINUI_PLANS_DIR, paths.plans_dir, SUPERVISOR_URL
fn clean() -> u32 {
    let c = '"'; // a char literal that must not open a string
    let _ = c;
    2
}

#[cfg(windows)]
fn only_windows() {
    let _ = std::process::Command::new("taskkill").arg("/F").status();
}

#[cfg(not(windows))]
fn only_windows() {}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    fn helper() -> &'static str {
        "http://localhost:8000"
    }
    #[test]
    fn t() {
        let _ = ("D:/x", "/home/me", 9875, "qontinui-web/backend", "0f8fad5b-d9cb-469f-a165-70867728950e");
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
fn test_only_helper() -> &'static str {
    "powershell"
}

#[cfg(test)]
use std::env::var as _unused_in_tests;

// cfg predicates that are test-only without `test` coming first.
#[cfg(all(feature = "x", test))]
fn t1() -> &'static str {
    "http://localhost:8000"
}

#[cfg(all(
    test,
    feature = "y"
))]
fn t2() -> &'static str {
    "C:/Users/x"
}

// A cfg(test) module nested inside a cfg(windows) one is still test-only.
#[cfg(windows)]
mod win_only {
    #[cfg(test)]
    mod tests {
        fn t() -> &'static str {
            "http://localhost:8000"
        }
    }
}

// Platform modules with a sibling of the same fn: no structural hit.
#[cfg(windows)]
mod plat {
    pub fn open() {}
}

#[cfg(any(unix, target_os = "macos"))]
mod plat {
    pub fn open() {}
}
